note: Free provincial recreation-site campground on Reindeer Lake ~5 km W of Southend, on a gravel road off Hwy 102: a small loop of rustic sites in spruce forest back from the shore, with a boat launch and fish-cleaning station. Store with fuel in Southend. --Claude
